description: Cross-runtime decision parity fixture. Every runtime that makes lexical decisions (Rust olaya-core, Rust olaya-wasm, Node olaya) must select expected_curie for each state; the Python lexical router (olaya.candidate_router) must rank it first. Scorers differ per runtime, so the states are built to carry unambiguous lexical evidence: the expected concept matches several label/synonym tokens and no competitor matches more than one. See spec/AXIOMS.md, 'Decision parity'.

concepts.label: Operational Incident
concepts.description: Any event degrading a production service.

concepts.label: Data Incident
concepts.description: Problems with databases and persistent storage.

concepts.label: Database Deadlock
concepts.description: Transactions waiting on each other's row locks.

concepts.label: Disk Full
concepts.description: A storage volume has run out of free space.

concepts.label: Billing Incident
concepts.description: Failures in payments, invoices or subscriptions.

concepts.label: DNS Resolution Failure
concepts.description: Hostnames cannot be resolved to addresses.

concepts.label: Security Incident
concepts.description: Unauthorized access to systems or data.

concepts.label: Credential Leak
concepts.description: A secret or key was exposed outside its trust boundary.

queries.state: Postgres deadlock detected while locking customer rows
queries.note: Only one synonym token matches; the lifted ancestors tie with the leaf and the most specific concept must win.

queries.state: Invoice payment charge failed, customer card declined at checkout
queries.note: The parent (billing) matches two synonyms, the child matches label, synonyms and description.

queries.state: DNS resolution failure: lookup returned NXDOMAIN for api hostname
queries.note: Label and synonym evidence on a depth-2 concept; 'api' touches an unrelated branch.

queries.state: Leaked API key exposed in a public repository, unauthorized access suspected
queries.note: The parent (security) matches its own synonym and description but the child matches more.

queries.state: Root volume full, no disk space left on the storage node, invoice export stalled
queries.note: Exercises disjointness: 'invoice' routes the billing branch into the subgraph, the data branch is lifted above the threshold, so billing must be zeroed (expected_excluded is checked by the engines that run the projection kernel).
